clips.title: The story
paras: Legacy Reward: Replica Ironforge Air Rifle marks the collection of a mysterious package held on your behalf. Left behind by an unidentified messenger, the parcel was narrowly saved from being dumped into the sea before reaching your hands.

A mysterious parcel addressed specifically to you was dropped off with an unwilling caretaker. The unknown courier insisted you would arrive to collect it, leaving so swiftly that the receiver could not even refuse delivery. Fortunately, you arrived just before the unclaimed box was tossed into the ocean alongside the evening's refuse.

Inside the delivered parcel is a Replica Ironforge Air Rifle, a souvenir honoring the renowned firearm traditions of the dwarven capital. While dwarven mountaineers and marksmen carry deadly firepower through Dun Morogh, replicas like this celebrate the intricate barrelwork and pneumatic mechanisms perfected by Ironforge craftsmen.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Wait, wait, you said your name was friend?

Friend! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!
Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.
What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!
